title: Trader Joe’s
paragraphs: Chandler, AZ

LANDCOR provided complete Civil Engineering services for this brand new Trader Joe’s location in Chandler, AZ. Scope of work included Grading & Drainage, Utility Design, SWPPP, and Construction Admin.

title: CCV Queen Creek
paragraphs: Queen Creek, AZ

CCV Queen Creek was a ground-up 15-acre church campus project. The campus includes a large sanctuary, classrooms, outdoor grill and seating area, and large outdoor sports field. LANDCOR provided full-service Surveying and Civil Engineering services for the project.

title: CMC Steel Arizona
paragraphs: Mesa, AZ

Landcor has been involved with several on-going projects with CMC Steel Arizona. The existing 75-acre site is a private steel “micro mill” facility for recycling scrap steel. The most current project involved expansion of operations including buildings and infrastructure for administration offices and a fabrication shop. Landcor was responsible for preparation of civil construction documents for site work including new parking lots and driveways; retention and storm drain facilities; and relocation and extension of site utilities.

title: Echo Canyon
paragraphs: Maricopa County, AZ

Echo Canyon is a luxury home subdivision in northeast Maricopa County. Landcor provided civil engineering services for the community’s infrastructure, including a new roadway alignment carved through mountainous terrain and a bridge crossing over a FEMA-designated floodplain.

title: 135 Castle Rock
paragraphs: Sedona, AZ

135 Castle Rock is a luxury vacation rental development in Sedona, Arizona, with architectural design by The Ranch Mine. LANDCOR served as the civil engineer of record and provided complete civil design services, including grading and drainage design, utility design/coordination, and agency permitting support. LANDCOR also supported the project during construction with construction administration services.
Photos courtesy of The Ranch Mine

title: The Grove
paragraphs: Chandler, AZ

This Project is the second phase of a multi-phase church campus development on 20.7 acres in Chandler, Arizona. Site improvements included with the new worship center and classroom buildings consist of a parking lot expansion, access drive to Queen Creek Road, re-configuration of the sports fields and hardscape/landscape improvements. Landcor Consulting provided a full range of civil engineering services from schematic design through completion of construction.
Images courtesy of DeBartolo Architects.

title: Redemption Church
paragraphs: Gilbert, AZ
LANDCOR provided Civil Design services for this new church sanctuary project in Gilbert, AZ.

title: 5114 Casa Blanca
paragraphs: Paradise Valley, AZ

LANDCOR provided comprehensive civil engineering services for this striking mid-century modern–inspired custom home in Paradise Valley. Set on 1.2 acres, the 8,000-square-foot residence features 5 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, and a clean, modern design that complements its desert setting.
Photos courtesy of Vasbinder Development

title: CCV Surprise
paragraphs: Surprise, AZ

Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) is a multi-congregational church with campuses throughout the Phoenix Metro area. Landcor has provided civil design services for multiple campus expansion projects. Some of these services have included grading and drainage, water, sewer, and utility coordination.

title: ASU West Solar
paragraphs: Phoenix, AZ

This project is an approximately 15-acre 2 MW solar photovoltaic ground-mount system located on ASU's west campus at the intersection of Thunderbird Road and 51st Avenue. Landcor provided civil construction documents including grading and drainage and environmental compliance documentation (SWPPP).

title: Liberty Market
paragraphs: Gilbert, AZ

Liberty Market is a reconditioned grocery store reinvented as a modern dining and urban grocery space located in Gilbert at the intersection of Gilbert Road and Page Avenue. Landcor provided construction documents for the installation or modification of civil improvements including sidewalks, ramps, street signage, curbing and utilities adjacent to the site and coordination with the Town of Gilbert's Water Tower Park project.

title: Tates Buick/GMC Dealership
paragraphs: Show Low, AZ
LANDCOR was responsible for the Civil design for this new car dealership in Show Low, AZ. Scope of work included Grading & Drainage, Utilities, and Stormwater Pollution Prevention.

title: Sherwin Williams
paragraphs: Chandler, AZ

LANDCOR provided complete Civil Engineering services for this brand-new Sherwin Williams location in Chandler, AZ. Scope of work included Grading & Drainage, Utility Design, SWPPP, and Construction Admin.

title: Barnone
paragraphs: Gilbert, AZ

Barnone is a Craftsmen Community located in Agritopia in Gilbert, AZ. The project involved the adaptive re-use of an existing 1950s Quonset hut and the construction of two new buildings along with complete site/landscape improvements. Barnone provides retail space for local small business owners, restaurateurs, as well as a winery.
Renderings courtesy of DeBartolo Architects.

title: Dutch Bros. Coffee
paragraphs: Dutch Bros. Coffee are small drive-thru/walk up coffee shops located throughout Arizona and the west coast. Landcor provided civil engineering design services for locations in Phoenix, Mesa, and Tempe.

title: Neighborhood Ministries
paragraphs: Phoenix, AZ

With this adaptive re-use project, abandoned silos were renovated to house a preschool, after-school program, and administrative offices for Neighborhood Ministries. The project was selected for an Award of Merit by ENR Southwest in 2017.
Landcor provided full service civil consulting services throughout the project.

title: Mohawk Rose Commerce Park
paragraphs: Phoenix, AZ

Mohawk Rose Commerce Park is a 15 acre commercial/industrial subdivision located in Phoenix at the intersection of 28th Street and Mohawk Road. LANDCOR provided consulting services from the initial re-zoning of the property through design, platting and completion of construction. The project involved typical subdivision improvements along with significant off-site water and sewer extensions. LANDCOR also provide site civil engineering for several parcels within the subdivision.

title: Scottsdale Bible Church
paragraphs: Scottsdale, AZ

Scottsdale Bible Church (“SBC”) is a 20 acre church campus located at the southeast corner of Shea Boulevard and Miller Road at 7601 E. Shea Boulevard. This major church campus renovation project included modernization of existing buildings, greater functional efficiency, visually stunning spaces, improved pedestrian safety and flow, and further development of site work and landscaping. Changes that are more significant include the demolition of two buildings and a pedestrian bridge, the construction of three new buildings, north parking lot and hardscape improvements.

Landcor Consulting provided a full range of civil engineering services including ALTA/ASCM Land Title Survey, Final Plat, preliminary & final grading & drainage plans, water/sewer plans, demolition plans, and Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPP) in addition to a range of post design civil construction services.

title: USCIS
paragraphs: Phoenix, AZ

This project is an adaptive renovation of an old Smitty's/Walgreens commercial center located at the southwest corner of Buckeye Road and 16th Street. The new facility accommodates the GSA/USCIS (United States Citizenship and Immigration Services) Phoenix District and field offices. This is the first phase of a 20 acre multi-phase redevelopment project. The site work for this initial phase included re-conditioning of the existing parking lot; new curb, sidewalk and landscape areas; retention and storm drain facilities; and relocation of site utilities. Landcor provided site civil engineering for the project as well as coordination of LEED certification and surveying services.
